beats.headline: The prize for being watched
beats.text: Awarded for gathering a following, or for doing something in front of enough people that the following gathers itself. The contents are put to an audience vote, and the box will not open for thirty hours, so the crawler carries it around knowing that strangers are arguing about what they deserve.

beats.headline: The holdings of the defeated
beats.text: The legendary fan box rises as a cobra head to the ceiling of the safe room, earned because a large share of the Naga system was watching Carl just before he executed Rishi. By a Naga jury's vote it is his wedding gift: the holdings of the defeated. What comes out is garbage. Wet, scorched clothes, wrecked furniture, a shot-through microwave, a melted trophy for eighth place at GreaserBall with the place removed from the plaque. It keeps coming until the pile nearly reaches the ceiling and blocks the bathroom. The box allows that there might be a useful thing or two in there.
